author: Nelev
body:
Brings #32 onto `main`. #32 was stacked on #31 and merged into `feat/clerk-auth` after #31 had already landed, so its commits never reached `main`. This PR is exactly those commits (#31's are already on `main`); see #32 for the full description.

- medas-api verifies the Clerk session token and takes the user from it alone; `userId` is gone from `/ask`
- `users.clerk_user_id` (migration) links an account to its row by verified email on first sign-in; no match → `403`
- Every conversation read and write is scoped to the signed-in user; `/health/db` stays public
- The UI sends the token as `Authorization: Bearer …`

## Deploy notes

- `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` in `medas-api/.env`; `uv run alembic upgrade head`
